result:
`./compile.sh` reports success (the deprecation note is expected since it exercises the two deprecated `CSVParser` constructors documented in the spec).

Created `tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVParserAgentTest.java` covering:
- All static `parse(...)` factories (String/Reader/File/Path/URL/InputStream) plus their documented null-argument contracts (NPE or IAE as specified).
- Deprecated constructors, including the record-number/offset variant.
- `CSVParser.Builder` (`builder()`, `setReader`, `setFormat`, `setRecordNumber`, `setCharacterOffset`, `setByteOffset`, `setTrackBytes`).
- `getRecordNumber`/`getCurrentLineNumber` progression, `getFirstEndOfLine`.
- `getHeaderMap` (contents + independent-copy semantics), `getHeaderMapRaw`, `getHeaderNames` (order + read-only).
- Header/trailer comment detection (`hasHeaderComment`/`getHeaderComment`, `hasTrailerComment`/`getTrailerComment`), including default "no comment" cases.
- `isClosed`/`close`, `iterator()` (normal traversal, exhaustion `NoSuchElementException`, behavior after `close()`, IOException→`IllegalStateException` rethrow via a custom failing `Reader`).
- `getRecords()` (empty input, resuming from current position, `UncheckedIOException` on read failure), package-private `nextRecord()` returning `null` at EOF, and `stream()`.

All code is Java 8-compatible (no diamond operators, lambdas, or underscored literals) and self-contained within the single file.
